Skip any line whose first token equals "NUMBER" (or is empty) before converting the next line’s two tokens to integers for the number of vehicles and their capacity. When adding a time dimension with `routing.AddDimension`, the third argument (`slack_max`) must be an integer (int64). Ensure any computed horizon or slack values are cast to `int` (e.g., `int(horizon)`) before passing them to `AddDimension`. This prevents the “argument … of type 'int64_t'” TypeError.

When adding the time dimension, set the “slack_max” (second argument) to a value at least as large as the maximum due date (e.g., the largest DUE DATE among all customers plus the longest possible travel time). Using a zero or too‑small slack forces the solver to treat early arrivals as infeasible, causing time‑window violations.
